transcript.text: Hello, this is a call from Mumbai Bank. May I speak with Rakesh Sharma?
Yes, this is Rakesh Sharma speaking. What is this call regarding?

Thank you for confirming, Mr. Sharma. I'm calling to remind you that your minimum payment of Rs 4,820 for your Mumbai Bank credit card was due on 2026-10-15. As of today, the payment is overdue.

To avoid further interest charges of 3.5% per month, and a late fee of Rs 750 if your outstanding balance is above Rs 10,000, we request you to make at least the minimum payment as soon as possible.

Could you please let me know when you will be able to make this payment, and for what amount?
Actually, I already paid that amount two days ago through UPI. Can you please check your records again?

Thank you for letting me know, Mr. Sharma. May I confirm—your payment of Rs 4,820 was made via UPI two days ago? Your payment should reflect in our records within 2 working days. If you have just paid recently, it may take a little while to update.

If you have any further concerns or would like to provide any additional details, please let me know. Thank you for your prompt action.
Yes, that's right. I made the payment via UPI on the 16th. Please double-check your system; I’m certain the payment went through.
